$comment: Community-maintained overlay for the data-center layer (L4).
FracTracker's dataset records the facility. It does not record whether a
community has organised in response — and that is precisely the field an
organizer needs (spec §6 L4, F10). Rather than invent it, we keep it here
as a reviewable file that anyone can add to by pull request.
Match on `facilityId` (the slug printed by `npm run data:datacenters`) or,
more robustly, on `name` + `city`. Every entry must cite a public source.
Entries describe organisations and campaigns — never individual people.
